newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.050pts to 101.585.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.050pts to 101.585.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.050 points in Wednesday's trading to 101.585, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.485 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.102 points to 97.865 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.357 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 2.653 points to 1,117.262.
